==40%==
In 1993, Christmas Day fell on a Saturday. What day of the week was New Year’s Day in 1994?

'''Saturday''': New Year’s Day is always the same day of the week as the Christmas Day it follows.

==35%==
{| class="fandom-table"
! colspan="5" |Lee likes to eat his Christmas dinner in a particular order. He eats the red cabbage with cranberries before he tucks into the honey-roasted parsnips but after the carrots. He devours the Brussels sprouts with chestnuts before the pigs in blankets but after the parsnips. What does he eat first?
|-
|Red cabbage with cranberries
|Honey-roasted parsnips
|'''Carrots'''
|Brussels sprouts with chestnuts
|Pigs in blankets
|}
Carrots then red cabbage, parsnips, sprouts and finally the pigs in blankets.

==30%==
What Christmas item completes this list?

ENLIST LISTEN SILENT INLETS '''TINSEL'''

They are all anagrams of each other and ‘tinsel’ is the only Christmas item that can complete the list.

== 25% ==
Harry puts six elves up as Christmas decorations:

[[File:Elves.png|frameless]]

Harry’s favourite is the one that, as you look at them, is three to the left of the one that is directly to the right of the one that is four to the right of Merry. What is the name of Harry’s favourite elf?

Four to the right of Merry is Cheery. Directly to the right of Cheery is Smiley. Three to the left of Smiley is Happy.

'''16'''
